knowledge_gaps.message: AFFECTS FailureMode:fm_purge_filter_contaminated → Component:comp_filter: la pipeline ha indicato pagina 24 senza una citazione verificabile.
CorrectiveAction:ca_replace_theta_motor_belt non è collegabile a un'evidenza PDF canonica.
AFFECTS:fm_optic_contaminated:comp_optic non è collegabile a un'evidenza PDF canonica.
AFFECTS:fm_fluid_hose_leaking_or_damaged:comp_hoses esclusa perché almeno un estremo non ha provenienza risolvibile.
CorrectiveAction 'Maintain normal operating temperature' has instruction_text without any restorative action step (it reads like a cause, observation, or inspection note).
FailureMode 'Linear bearing is worn or damaged' has material_context='Y-axis linear bearing on the linear rail' which is not a Component.component_id.
The evidence for RESOLVED_BY only states that improper cleaning may damage optics and does not state that the cited procedure resolves that failure mode.
The evidence for the pressure-transducer AFFECTS relation only states the transducer's location; it does not directly support that the cited failure mode affects the transducer.

The pressure-transducer failure mode is linked to the Eastman service escalation, but the cited evidence only says calibration should be performed when prior settings are undesirable and does not mention contacting service.
FailureMode 'fm_round_knife_blade_seized' participates in relation(s) whose evidence quote was not found on the cited page: RESOLVED_BY(fm_round_knife_blade_seized → ca_replace_round_knife_blade).
Symptom 'Y-Car Cutting Calibration Affected' has no MAY_INDICATE relation to a FailureMode.
FailureMode 'Reduced blower pressure at high altitude' has no RESOLVED_BY relation to a CorrectiveAction.
Symptom 'Cutter may not operate correctly due to temperature' is not connected to any Asset in the graph.
